_doc: STAGING. The Stoop — vocabulary shipped long before any board did, which pack-radar flagged as [ready]: 107 words, density 159, zero boards. Authored 2026-08-28 against the named/said tiers, not against the whole vocabulary entry, after measuring on-theme the wrong way cost three boards a rebuild the same day. CULTURAL: bench gate PASSES (the vocabulary is signed), the per-pack community reader is still outstanding and is the condition on commercial ship.

theme.name: The Stoop
theme.blurb: The front room of the block, and everybody who passes has to be spoken to.

boards.scene: The top step, and the view it owns

clues.posted: Where she has been since two, and everyone coming up the block gets named before they arrive
clues.post: The metal one at the corner, leaned on by three generations and still standing
clues.step: The third one up, which is hers, and you learn that without being told
clues.pot: The one on the sill with a plant in it that has outlived two tenants
clues.set: What the domino table gets before anybody has agreed to play
clues.spot: Saved with a folded jacket, and defended more seriously than the game

boards.scene: The car at the curb, and whose it is

clues.impala: Kept at the curb under a cover, washed far more often than it is driven
clues.lamp: What comes on at the corner about the time the little ones get called in
clues.mail: Held for the whole building by whoever is out front when it comes
clues.pail: Filled at the hydrant, carried two-handed, and half of it never arrives
clues.palm: Where the folded dollar goes when somebody's grandmother wins the hand
clues.limp: How the man from the third floor takes the stairs, and the rail was put in for him

boards.scene: The long talk, and who is allowed to end it

clues.honest: What the block is about your business, whether or not you asked it to be
clues.stone: The one in the wall every kid has sat on, worn smooth and slightly loose
clues.hose: Dragged out in July, and the argument is always about who pays for the water
clues.shoe: Kicked off at the door and left there, because nobody is going anywhere tonight
clues.note: Taped to the door for the one person who never answers her phone
clues.nest: What the birds built in the awning, and now nobody will touch it

boards.scene: The hour before the lights come on

clues.golden: What everybody calls the twenty minutes before the lights come on
clues.gold: What the trim on her front door has been repainted, three times, by her own hand
clues.lend: The ladder, the big pot and the phone charger all travel, and all come back eventually
clues.dog: Tied to the rail, and greeted by more people than his owner is
clues.nod: The whole greeting, if you have already spoken once today
clues.done: She gets up and folds the chair, and that is the announcement

boards.scene: The milk crate, and who it belongs to

clues.carted: How the whole setup came down three flights, in two trips, and nobody offered to help
clues.crate: Upturned, and it has been a seat, a table and a step ladder in one afternoon
clues.trade: What happens between the top step and the corner, and money rarely enters it
clues.card: Slapped down hard enough to make the table jump, which is the entire point
clues.cat: Belongs to nobody and is fed by four apartments
clues.dare: What the youngest one takes, off the top step, exactly once
